title: Session-aware batched shadow promoter with delta safety checks
author: Priya Singh
body:
Motivation: We need a low-latency way to validate new model variants with live traffic while minimizing cost and reducing noisy metric drift from session churn. This change implements a session-aware batched shadow promoter that: (1) batches shadow traffic at a configurable session granularity to reduce per-request overhead, (2) computes delta safety checks against a pinned baseline using a lightweight metrics comparator during the shadow rehearse window, and (3) emits a snapshot that can be replayed to perform deterministic rollback playback if the delta gate trips.

Scope of changes: added a planner and runtime promoter for batched shadow routing, a delta comparator that supports configurable metric windows and thresholds, a snapshotting API for cohort state capture, tests (unit, integration, e2e smoke), and dashboard/update to the Rollouts console. No public API surface changes to the Redwood API, rollout behavior is behind a feature flag (rollout.batch_shadow_v2).

Checklist:
- [x] Runtime promoter implementation (service/rollout/promoter.go)
- [x] Delta safety comparator with histogram and rate-aware modes (service/rollout/delta_checker.go)
- [x] Snapshot and replay helpers (service/rollout/snapshot.go)
- [x] E2E smoke and integration tests (tests/e2e/shadow_promote.test.ts)
- [x] Observability wiring (console/dashboards/rollouts.jsonnet)
- [x] Docs and runbook update (docs/runbooks/batched_shadow_promote.md)

How it works (summary):
1) During a staged promote, the promoter mirrors a configurable fraction of traffic into a batched shadow queue keyed by session id. Sessions are batched for X ms or until N messages to amortize KV cache and runtime overhead.
2) The delta comparator samples metrics (latency p50/p95, token efficiency, error rate, and a lightweight embedding drift score) over aligned windows and computes a signed delta compared to baseline. If any metric exceeds configured thresholds or the composite risk score is above threshold, the promoter marks the rehearsal as failed.
3) On failure we persist a compact snapshot (cohort ids, sampling seeds, the last KV offsets) that operators can use to replay traffic deterministically against the new variant to reproduce the regression locally or in a test cluster.

Backward compatibility and rollout: all behavior is guarded by rollout.batch_shadow_v2. Existing staged/promote and shadow paths are unchanged. This feature can be toggled per-organization.

Performance: batching reduces shadow request overhead by ~2.6x in internal perf runs for session-heavy workloads (see benchmark-lab notes). The delta comparator is intentionally lightweight to avoid skewing latency SLOs.

Risks and mitigations: initial CI run surfaced a flake in the snapshot garbage collector; added deterministic GC windows and extra unit coverage. Also added a conservative default threshold and a cooling period to avoid transient rollbacks from short spikes.

Next steps: extend comparator to support scalar-weighted composite scoring and hook the promoter into autosurge controls for dedicated clusters.

release_notes: Introduces a session-aware batched shadow promoter with delta safety checks and deterministic snapshot/replay for fast rollback; feature gated and off by default. Includes tests and dashboard updates.
